recorded_summary.scope: Pane-specific absolute dimensions and checksum-visible PTY generations only; offsets, gaps, incomplete and inconclusive samples are not verified.

limitations: No physical-display guarantee or complete display-frame coverage: SCK requested60fps, but statuses/PTS gaps are retained. Candidate has11 timestamp gaps; negative has214; these are not isolated performance benchmarks.

No actual MTLDrawable presented-handler proof, same-frame native pane-local offset references, or AppKit live-resize begin/end callbacks. Phase effectiveness comes from changed PTY geometry plus captured callbacks; callback receipt time can lag acquisition.

Correct classification means absolute marker dimensions and validated barcode where available, not every glyph/pixel/offset verified. Inconclusive frames are not converted to passing frames by manual inspection.
Negative failure classification takes priority over inconclusive panes, so zero inconclusive_complete_frames in that run does not mean no markers were missing during startup.
Videos are finalized and hash-linked; this review inspected listed PNGs and traces, not every video frame.
